stem: Why can one product sample not prove a large drying load is uniform?
choices: Spatial and material variability can exist across positions, so representative sampling is needed for the scope of the claim.
One sample always represents a room.
Uniformity is determined only by fixture settings.
Water activity is identical within a cultivar.
